name: profile-setup-empty
description: Regression spec for a fresh install: /profile must offer a direct setup-wizard action when no /setup-created profiles exist.

config.command: bash -lc 'R=$(pwd); H=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$H/.kollab"; printf "%s" "{\"plugins\":{\"hub\":{\"enabled\":false}}}" > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; ln -s "$R/plugins" "$H/plugins"; cd "$H"; HOME="$H" PYTHONPATH="$R" "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --no-daemon'

steps.description: empty state offers a setup action
built-in profiles are not presented as configured profiles
empty-state action opened the setup wizard

steps.pattern: Which provider|Paste your API key|sign in with ChatGPT
